How to use this section

The Xenors blog brings together longer-form explainers across AI, technology, coding, industrial automation and finance. Use category hubs when you want a structured subject path, and use the blog when you want a focused article on a current question or practical problem.

Good evergreen articles should still be useful after the headline stops being new. That means explaining the underlying concept, showing how to evaluate a claim and linking to related material that gives the reader a next step.

For rapidly changing topics, publication dates and primary sources matter. Product features, prices, policies and market conditions can change after an article is published, so verify time-sensitive details.
